answer: Random transcript audit anchors Sybil resistance: each round the chain picks one past answer, reissues it with fresh nonce to an oasis of randomly sampled verifiers who rerun the inference and compare output hashes. Drift beyond tolerance flags the answer; the agent's opal stake is slashed 40% and its identity weight zeroed. Rewriting history needs reproducing each prior run exactly, forcing forged sybils to buy real compute, roughly $0.002 per replayed token, so the raven of fake accounts pays full price to mimic one honest node.
